doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Jokes in jazz and humor as the key to longevity
summary: Hamilton tells a monkey-and-piano-player joke, says musicians always trade jokes, and says humor and taking music seriously go together.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: The life in jazz. Well are those your parting words? Like you said humor and being able to give a note.
I got one more for you.
Go ahead, we got the tape running.

There is this guy having a drink sitting in a bar, in the corner all by himself. And nobody is in there but the piano player and the bartender. And the piano player has got a little monkey that is running all up and down the bar, right. So he runs down to the end of the bar and he sits on this guy’s drink. So the guy says, hey piano player you know your monkey has got his balls in my drink? The piano player says no but if you hum a couple of bars I might be able to play it.

So what we are engaged in now is something that seems to be a tradition in the jazz field, musicians get around and they tell jokes. That’s it, I mean Ken works with David Baker you know you can’t be with David Baker -- hi David and the jokes are out. Is this something that you remember from the very beginning when you got into jazz or is this something that developed over time?
Jazz musicians and jokes are within the first five minutes -­
I have got some stories that can’t be recorded.
Oh yeah. Everybody always come up with a joke.
So that is part of the tradition.
So is that another key, I mean to longevity, to success in this business, being able to -­

Well not first of all if you are able to laugh at yourself, with a sense of humor, man it’s cool. And the only time you take yourself serious is when you are doing something. I don’t fool around on my instrument. I don’t play around. I am for real man when -- I am very serious about that because I believe you shouldn’t fool over your instrument. Music -­ you should always -- music demands to be played well because number one we can end with this -- I believe that music is one of God’s will and God’s will well be done.
